---
# One template for every exam report. render.py renders it once per exam config:
#   REPORT_CONFIG="US/June Regents/report.yml" quarto render report.qmd --metadata-file <title.yml>
# Sections are "## Title {#anchor nav="Nav label"}"; the number badges and the sticky
# nav are built automatically from them, so to add, drop or reorder a section just edit
# this file. Sections that only appear for some exams are printed from Python with
# lib.md_section(). The analysis and charts live in report_lib.py.
lang: en
format:
  html:
    minimal: true
    embed-resources: true
    section-divs: true
    css: assets/report.css
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="icon" type="image/webp" href="https://www.westinghousehs.org/images/index-page/gwhs-logo.webp">
        <script src="assets/plotly.min.js"></script>
    include-after-body: assets/report-nav.html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
jupyter: python3
---

```{python}
#| output: asis
import os
import report_lib as lib

config = os.environ.get('REPORT_CONFIG', 'US/June Regents/report.yml')  # set by render.py

lib.write_plotly_js('assets/plotly.min.js')
x = lib.prepare(lib.load_config(config))
print(lib.raw(lib.hero_html(x)))
```

::: {.main}

## At a Glance {#overview nav="Overview"}

::: {.subtitle}
Bars are shaded by performance band; the dotted line marks the average.
:::

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(lib.raw(lib.kpi_html(x.df, x.nq) + lib.to_div(lib.fig_histogram(x.df, x.nq))))
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
if x.has_scale:
    print(lib.md_section('Regents Scale Scores', 'scale', 'Scale Score',
        lib.scale_section_html(x.df, x.conv, x.written, x.subject, x.show_classes),
        'Shading shows performance Levels 1–5; the dotted line marks passing.'))
if x.show_classes:
    print(lib.md_section('Class & Period Performance', 'class-period', 'Classes',
        lib.class_period_html(x.df, x.nq)))
```
